WITH category_stats AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    AVG(CASE
      WHEN spent IS NOT NULL AND spent <> 0
       AND amount IS NOT NULL AND amount <> 0
      THEN (spent - amount) * 1.0 / amount
    END) AS avg_relative_overspend,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count
  FROM budget
  GROUP BY category
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(line_count) AS avg_line_count
  FROM category_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(cs.avg_relative_overspend) AS avg_category_relative_overspend,
  AVG(cs.line_count) AS avg_category_line_count,
  AVG(cs.line_count - o.avg_line_count) AS avg_excess_line_count
FROM category_stats cs
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE cs.line_count > o.avg_line_count
